sql:
WITH month_dates AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT substr(txn_date, 1, 7) as month
  FROM customer_transactions
  ORDER BY month
),
customer_monthly AS (
  SELECT 
    substr(txn_date, 1, 7) as txn_month,
    customer_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount 
             WHEN txn_type = 'purchase' THEN -txn_amount 
             WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN -txn_amount 
             ELSE 0 END) as monthly_net
  FROM customer_transactions
  GROUP BY substr(txn_date, 1, 7), customer_id
),
all_customers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM customer_transactions
),
cumulative AS (
  SELECT 
    m.month,
    ac.customer_id,
    COALESCE(SUM(cm.monthly_net), 0) as cumulative_balance
  FROM month_dates m
  CROSS JOIN all_customers ac
  LEFT JOIN customer_monthly cm ON cm.customer_id = ac.customer_id AND cm.txn_month <= m.month
  GROUP BY m.month, ac.customer_id
),
monthly_totals AS (
  SELECT month, 
         SUM(cumulative_balance) as total_balance 
  FROM cumulative 
  GROUP BY month 
  ORDER BY month
)
SELECT * FROM monthly_totals
